retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast 1950s-style graphic layout featuring flat, stylized cartoon characters with expressive hand-drawn typography on a solid vibrant background.
excludeWhen: modern sleek sans-serif layouts are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant red composition featuring two stylized, anthropomorphic characters in black beatnik attire. The style is defined by flat color planes, thick jittery ink outlines, and large white areas for character bodies, contrasted against a saturated red field with bright green accents.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical character placement flanking a central text column
High contrast between white character bodies and solid red background
Rhythmic repetition of curved, feathery tail textures
Integration of hand-drawn display type with character silhouettes
coreInvariants: Black ink-style outlines with variable line weight
Limited palette of red, black, white, and bright green

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two large characters occupy the lower two-thirds of the frame, facing each other.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, white, textured tails that frame the composition on the left and right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the large display text at the top, down the central column of smaller text, to the character faces at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy use of solid red background to isolate and emphasize the white and black figures.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Solid Black for clothing and outlines
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Kelly Green for specific text and accessories
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation background with high value (white) focal points

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Irregular, hand-drawn sans-serif with varying weights
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'U' often appears wider than other vowels
The letter 'S' has a sharp, almost zig-zag spine
The letter 'Y' has a long, straight descender
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair large, irregular display lettering with smaller, more uniform hand-drawn block capitals for secondary information.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the playful, irregular weight of the display text
Mimics the jittery, mid-century hand-lettered look

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a flat red background with two stylized white cartoon squirrels in black beatnik suits and green shirts, featuring large feathery white tails that curve upward.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply hand-drawn, jittery black and green uppercase lettering in the top third and a central column, ensuring the text looks manually inked.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid, untextured red?
Do the characters have thick, irregular black outlines?
Is the typography visibly hand-drawn rather than a standard font?
Is the palette limited to red, black, white, and green?

mustRedesign: Avoid exact replication of the specific squirrel characters
postGenerationChecks: Verify line weight variation in outlines
Confirm text alignment follows the central column layout
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Flat Background Color] with [Stylized Character Archetype] in [Beatnik Attire] framed by [Textured Graphic Element] and topped with [Jittery Hand-Lettered Display Type].
